title: Screen-share pause edge is lost when its send fails
trigger: Share a window in a group call, hide the shared window so set_screen_paused sends toggleGroupCallScreenSharingIsPaused, with the send failing (native send error)
effect: Only the answered-error arm (calls/error.rs:257) reverts screen_share_paused; a send_json Err just takes the request. Both flags (ActiveScreen::paused, ActiveGroupCall::screen_share_paused) now say paused, the early return 'if !changed && was == paused' blocks any resend, so Telegram keeps showing the share live (frozen picture, no paused mark) until the next edge
fix: Make the pause a stage of the share (GroupScreenShare::Sharing{paused: Told|Asking(RequestId)|Failed}) so a failed send leaves it unsent and the pump resends

title: baseline-style: the share's paused mark is kept three times by hand (skip 'stays the bool beside it' does not hold)
trigger: set_screen_paused, pump_shared_screen (wanted None), stop_sharing_screen, toggle_group_call_screen_share, screen_chooser demo and the error arm each write screen_share_paused with the share stage
effect: No bug today; ActiveScreen::paused, ActiveGroupCall::screen_share_paused and GroupScreenShare change together by hand. Section 8 (is-02 Review fixes, Merge) keeps the bool because it is 'written with the share's stage', an effort reason
fix: GroupScreenShare::{Off, Pending, On{paused}} (one value); CallScreen reads it instead of holding its own paused

title: EngineWait::{Idle, Waiting} is Option<Instant> inside Share::Picked, reset by hand
trigger: Pick a source while the engine has no frame sender
effect: Two-variant enum beside the real stage: pump_shared_screen sets wait back to Idle by hand when wanted is None (call_screen.rs:557) and close_active builds Picked{wait: Idle}; the Running stage has no equivalent
fix: Share::Picked{since: Option<Instant>} set by one transition, or Share::WaitingForEngine{pick, since}

title: Two driver timers have no deadline in next_deadline: the 10 s engine wait and the 5 s level-tap reopen
trigger: Pick a screen source when the engine never offers a sender, then leave the app idle; or let the raw level tap fail in a group call
effect: EngineWait::expired is only evaluated when the pump runs; flood_retry.rs next_deadline lists call_audio_deadline (Open only) and call_capture.until_reopen but not these two, so the share reads as live-with-nothing-sent, and CallAudio::Failed is not retried, until some unrelated wake

title: A picked source (or Ended error) outlives its call and is used by the next call
trigger: Choose a source in the screen chooser, never start sharing (or end the call before the share runs), then start a share in another call
effect: pump_shared_screen with wanted None only resets Picked's wait; Picked{pick} and Ended{error} stay in the driver. call_screen_source_available() (calls/mod.rs:194) then reports a source for the new call without the chooser, and the old source is captured. Only Running is cleared with the call (close_active(false))
fix: Drop Picked/Ended when the call that wanted them is gone (Farewell of the call), keyed by CaptureTarget

title: data_storage_dirty is cleared before the save and its failure is dropped
trigger: Auto-download presets seed the per-network settings and the disk write fails (full disk, read-only folder)
effect: the dirty mark is reset first and the save result is discarded with let _, so the seeded settings are never retried and are lost on restart
fix: clear the mark only after save_data_storage_prefs returns Ok

title: Early ? in ingest skips one-shot continuations that nothing re-runs
trigger: run_post_ingest_pumps or maybe_continue_boost returns a send error on the envelope that makes the account Ready or completes a loadChats page
effect: became_ready work (preload forums, story paging, notification sounds, quick replies) and the load_chats_ok next-page send are skipped; was_ready is true on the next ingest so became_ready never fires again, and main paging only continues from an ok answer of an in-flight LoadChats, so the chat list stops paging
fix: run the Ready kickoff and paging continuations before fallible pumps, or record a pending kickoff stage that chat_list_tick retries

title: AI composer answers share one slot for all windows, a second answer overwrites the first
trigger: Ask AI to fix/compose text in the main window and in a chat window; both answers land in one poll batch before either window's upkeep drains
effect: messages.ai_composer_text / ai_composer_blocks is a single Option, written with = Some(..); the first window's answer is replaced and never applied, its ai_ask stays waiting
fix: queue answers keyed by the asking window and RequestId, or keep the answer in the window's own ask stage

title: begin_gift_manage ignores a refused getGiftCollections; collections_fetch stays Idle with no failure shown and no retry
trigger: Open a gifts list while the sender refuses the request: `let _ = self.fetch_gift_collections(owner)`
effect: collection tabs never load for that open; nothing re-asks until the list is reopened
fix: CollectionsFetch::Failed stage (or Fetch<Vec<GiftCollection>>) set on a refused send, with Retry

title: GiftManageState::deleting (Option<String>) is a second slot for the deleteGift in flight, beside hub.gifts_op (request) and PaymentsPurpose::DeleteGift
trigger: Delete a received gift: send_gift_mutation begins gifts_op, then the driver writes deleting after the send (the demo path in gift_manage_ui.rs writes it too)
effect: two fields that must change together; answer/error must clear both; demo and live write it from different places
fix: carry the gift id in the gifts_op stage variant (Mutating { request, kind: Delete(id) })

title: The per-owner/per-collection gifts list reset is written out by hand twice (select_gift_collection and premium_hub open): gifts, gifts_total, gifts_offset, gifts_page, gift_notice, gift_view select/confirm, flow, note
trigger: Switch collection tab versus open another owner's list
effect: a field added to one reset is missed in the other (rule 5: resets happen in one place)
fix: one GiftsList value replaced whole (list = GiftsList::new(owner, collection))

title: SendGiftState keeps open: bool, selected, stage and recipient in step by hand (close_send_gift, select_send_gift and open_send_gift_to each reset a different subset)
trigger: Close the send-gift box while a sendGift is out, reopen for the same recipient
effect: open=false while stage=Sending; reopening only flips open back; selected was cleared by close but stage kept
fix: SendGiftState as an enum Closed / Open { recipient, selection, stage } so Closed cannot hold Sending apart from the recipient

title: Stars burst animations are only (re)asked from the tail of maybe_fetch_live_story_extras, so an early return skips the retry
trigger: Open a live story; the first getCustomEmojiReactionAnimations send fails (live_story_request returns Err, live_bursts stays Unasked) or its answer errors (apply_live_story_error sets Unasked); streamer, donors and senders are already begun, so want is all false and the function returns before maybe_fetch_live_bursts
effect: No Stars effect bursts for this story; the retry comes only with the next Join. LiveBursts::Requested also holds no RequestId, and the answer is matched by purpose, so a dropped request leaves it Requested for the session
fix: LiveBursts::{Unasked, Requested{request: RequestId}, Loaded, Failed} asked from its own ingest step, not from the tail of the extras fetch

title: A commit of live-story Stars that did not go out is treated as never added, but TDLib still holds the pending Stars
trigger: Tap Stars, wait for the Undo window to end while the send fails; the commit batch is removed (commit_failed) and the note says not enough Stars
effect: The local pending amount is gone, TDLib still has the taps pending; the next tap plus commit sends the old and the new Stars together, more than the button showed
fix: On a failed send put the pending reaction back (with its due time), as the stage was before commit_reaction

title: hub dialog open flags are bools beside the data they guard
trigger: open_received_gifts sets gifts_open, gifts_owner, gifts, gifts_total, gifts_offset, gifts_page, gift_notice and gift_view one by one; stars_open sits beside tx and tx_selected the same way
effect: no new bug beyond c6-001, but every reset is by hand at the opener and the closer, and they differ
fix: enum per dialog (Closed / Open(state)) replaced whole

title: open_money_page returns on the first refused send and leaves the page open with nothing asked
trigger: Refuse sends, open Settings > Money: wallet.money is replaced with open:true, state_fetch send fails and returns; rates, explorer and history are never asked; ui/ton_wallet_money.rs:53 opens the box regardless of the Err
effect: The Money box opens with an empty history (Idle) and no Retry, because the Paged stage was never begun or failed
fix: Send all four reads, marking each Failed on a refused send (as fetch_wallet_history does), instead of returning at the first
